name: Freelance transcriptionist / captioner
summary: Transcribe or caption audio and video files from Rev's work queue and get paid per audio minute; new applicants currently face a waitlist.
whatYouDo: You pick audio or video files from Rev's online queue and type (or correct) what is said, following Rev's style guide; captioners also sync text to video. Pay is per minute of audio, so speed and accuracy determine what you earn per hour worked.
appeal: No degree or prior experience needed to apply
Choose your own hours and which files to take
Weekly PayPal payouts (per Rev's freelancer pages as indexed)
Captioning and subtitle-translation roles are listed at higher per-minute rates
watchOuts: Rev's freelancer page indicates a waitlist due to high application volume; secondary sources cite multi-week waits (one says 4–12 weeks, unverified)
Paid per audio minute, not per hour worked, so effective hourly pay is much lower than the headline rate
Rev cut base pay sharply in 2019 (Gizmodo reporting; worker petition cites $0.45 to $0.30 per minute)
Unpaid skills assessment and transcription sample required to apply
Independent contractor: no benefits and no guaranteed work
Canada appears on third-party lists of accepted countries, but the current official country list was not verified

training.notes: Must follow Rev's style guidelines; no paid training identified.

compensation.notes: Transcription range from Rev's freelancer pages as summarized in search results (pages could not be opened directly). Captioning listed at $0.54–$1.10 and subtitle translation at $1.70–$4.00+ per audio minute. Currency not stated in indexed text (Rev is US-based; likely USD). Older reviews cite a $0.30 floor.

reliability.notes: Waitlist for new applicants; work comes from a shared queue; 2019 pay cuts and earnings losses reported by journalists and workers. No official volume guarantee found.

applicationSteps: Choose a role (transcription, captions or subtitles) on Rev's freelancer page
Complete the short English/grammar skills assessment
Wait for an emailed decision (applications are waitlisted and processed in order received)
Set up PayPal to receive weekly payments
fitsIf: You type fast and accurately, have a good ear for English, and want flexible at-home work you can do in short sessions and can wait out a sign-up queue.
notFitIf: You need predictable hourly income soon or dislike repetitive, detail-heavy work paid by the piece.
